from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/filters/in_rtp.c","function":"rtpin_initialize","line":847,"var":"ctx->session->satip_server","code":"ctx->session->satip_server = gf_malloc(GF_MAX_PATH);","note":"SAT>IP initialization allocates a fixed-size heap buffer that will receive the parsed server name."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/filters/in_rtp.c","function":"rtpin_initialize","line":850,"var":"ctx->src","code":"rtpin_satip_get_server_ip(ctx->src, ctx->session->satip_server);","note":"The attacker-controlled satip:// URL is passed directly to the parser together with the fixed-size destination buffer."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/filters/in_rtp.c","function":"rtpin_satip_get_server_ip","line":72,"var":"text[1024]","code":"char schema[10], *test, text[1024], *retest;","note":"The parser uses a local stack buffer to assemble the extracted host string before copying it out."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/filters/in_rtp.c","function":"rtpin_satip_get_server_ip","line":117,"var":"text[i]","code":"text[i] = test[i];","note":"Each byte of the host portion is copied into the stack buffer without any bound check against the 1024-byte array."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/filters/in_rtp.c","function":"rtpin_satip_get_server_ip","line":120,"var":"Server","code":"strcpy(Server, text);","note":"The accumulated host string is copied into the heap buffer with strcpy, so an overlong SAT>IP host overflows the destination and triggers the stack-buffer-overflow write reported by ASAN."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/filter_core/filter.c","function":"gf_filter_new_finalize","line":532,"var":"filter->freg->initialize","code":"e = filter->freg->initialize(filter);","note":"Filter finalization invokes the RTP input filter initializer, which reaches the vulnerable SAT>IP parsing path during candidate execution."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
